description: Telegram Bot API for building bots - send messages, manage chats, webhooks, stickers

novel_features.name: Idempotent send
novel_features.description: Skip the API call when a previous send with the same idempotency key already succeeded for this bot and chat — returns the original message_id instead of re-sending.

novel_features.name: Replace-last status
novel_features.description: Edit the most recent message this bot sent to a chat in place — ideal for long-running job status that updates as steps complete.

novel_features.name: Sent-message history
novel_features.description: Browse the bot's outbound and inbound history filtered by chat, time window, sender, or media type — entirely from the local store, no API call.

novel_features.name: Activity audit
novel_features.description: Roll-up of outbound activity — messages by chat, by media type, error rate, last-send timestamp — one shot, no API call.

novel_features.name: HTML preflight and safe-escape
novel_features.description: Validate or auto-escape HTML before sending — catches Telegram's 'can't parse entities' 400 before it leaves the box.

novel_features.name: Channel publish with manifest
novel_features.description: Send a long-form post as one logical artifact — auto-split into chunks, recorded under a caller-chosen slug — then edit it later as a single unit.

novel_features.name: Chat resolver
novel_features.description: Resolve an @username to a stable numeric chat_id with local caching — transparently falls back to the API when the cache misses.
